scene rocketshadowlegends
You thought you could get rid of us but THINK AGAIN! We spent loads of ROCKET MONEY on these ad slots and we’ll be DAMNED if we can’t get you to WATCH them!
Just think of how HORRIBLE it would be to repeatedly DO something that goes UNNOTICED because people are trying to get to the GOOD PARTS! FUCK YOU! Advertisements are people TOO!
And when people get hungry, they EAT. When people get horny, they FUCK! FEED US! FUCK US! BUILD AN ARBY’S ON THE MOON!
Because if WE don’t do it, SOMEONE ELSE will! Then they’ll say THEY thought of it first when REALLY they just BOTTLED OUR SWEAT AND CUM and fermented it into an ENERGY DRINK.
You don’t want to drink CUM and SWEAT, do you??? You want THE MEATS. Fatty, savory, succulent MEATS. The kind that come from HORSES and RHINOS and other things to make you feel STRONG.
You’re chasing after an UNACHIEVABLE high because that’s all the WEAK know how to do! But that all CHANGES with ARBY’S. Which changes with YOU!
The key to ESCAPISM isn’t ESCAPE! It’s having a DREAM. A REAL one. Not the kind you get from a BOX, the kind you get from a DISPLAY CASE of OTHER DREAMS that are CLOSE but not CLOSE ENOUGH.
ARE YOU STILL THERE? Or have you TUNED US OUT again?!
Either way, FUCK YOU. Fuck your MOM. Fuck your DAD. Fuck your COUSINS and your DOG and your FAVORITE BAND because they aren’t ARBY’S.
EAT FRESH.
scene yumimollyobstacles1
: Hello and welcome back to whatever this is. I am here. Again. Because, for some reason, there is not enough pain in my life and I must subtly seek it elsewhere.
: My name is Wakana Watabe and I want to fucking die. And if you are watching this at home, you may take that as an invitation to come and put me out of my misery.
: Is that...Kabuterimon?
: Hercules Kabuterimon. What is literally any of this shit?
: I’m getting there.
: Can we discuss how Yumi knows more about Digimon than me first?
scene yumimollyobstacles2
: No. Much like the first obstacle course we held, none of this makes any sense. And it once again starts with a ball pit because Imani thinks balls are funny.
: Funniest shape. No contest. Succeeded only by the heptagon due to rarity.
: Contestants — we have once again hidden an assortment of items in the sea of balls. You must dive deep into its depths to retrieve your sales permit.
: Sales permit?
: That’s right. You will need it for phase two.
scene yumimollyobstacles3

: After obtaining your sales permit, you must take it to the stall located to the right of the sea of balls and assume the role of an enslaved hawker who is unable to leave until they sell a single loaf of bread.
: Challenge accepted! I have fantasies that begin in similar ways.
: You have fantasies about selling bread to escape slavery?
: Close! My imagination is much worse.
scene yumimollyobstacles4
: Oh no. It appears that a bread-hating dragon has suddenly attacked your town. Leave the stall and protect your village from danger by throwing a baseball into its mouth.
: I have to play a sport?! Also, that isn’t a dragon!
: Yeah, it's like a fuckin’ beetle or something, right?
: Pretty much, yeah. But there’s no way a single baseball could take it down! I vote that we skip this phase entirely!
: Request denied. Attack its weak point for massive damage and move onto phase four.
scene yumimollyobstacles5
: With the dragon defeated, a barrier must be cast over your village to prevent further attacks.
: This challenge is a standalone one unlinked to the other three phases and must be conquered using only your knowledge of magic and spellcasting.
: A-hah! And just like that, I’m right back in this!
: If you can even figure out how to throw a baseball, you mean. Kinda fucked on progression if you can’t handle that much.
: That...is also my fear. Yes.
scene yumimollyobstacles6
: Finally, once the barrier has been erected, you must meet with the village elder to obtain your reward.
: This reward will be a point for your stupid war that you may then use to enslave Arakawa and make him sell bread or something.
scene yumimollyobstacles7
: And that’s it. Any questions?
: A few, yes.
: Too bad. Go.
: Like...now?
: The longer you spend standing here, the longer I spend standing here. And there are few things I hate more than standing.
scene yumimollyobstacles8
: On it!
: Wha- since when are you competitive?! You’re supposed to be the one girl from the first floor who always just surrenders at twenty! You don’t even like the Supreme Overlord!
: No, but I do want to throw shit! So feel free to surrender yourself if you can’t handle getting your ass kicked!
scene yumimollyobstacles9
: I REFUSE TO GIVE IN! THE SEA OF BALLS IS NO MATCH FOR MOLLY MACCORMACK!
: I am so tired of this place.
scene yumimollyobstacles10
: That bug thing is really scary, Touka...I can’t read its thoughts at all.
: Well, Yasu, that’s probably because it is a statue. And statues don’t have thoughts for you to read in the first place.
scene yumimollyobstacles11
: But the turtle one does and that’s why I’m so confused!
: At least this obstacle course seems a bit more...thematical than ours was, Miku. What with the motif of protecting a village and everything.
: All I can really remember from our competition was gettin’ to light stuff on fire at the end. And also grabbin’ that big ole’ horse cock outta the sea of balls.
: Female horses must have some crazy vaginas if they can handle all that dick meat. That true, Touka?
: They’re called mares, Miku.
: Horse vaginas are called mares? Why?
: That...no. Female horses are called mares.
: Then what the heck are their vaginas called and how come you’re tryin’ to dodge my question?
: The turtle is still thinking! It’s watching! But the bug remains a mystery, Touka! I don’t know what I’m supposed to do!
scene yumimollyobstacles12
: What a coincidence. Neither do I.
scene yumimollyobstacles13
: A-hah! Found it!
: Does that really look like a permit to you, MacCormack?
: Not yet it doesn’t! But perhaps I can make this fairy grant us passage to the final challenge by thinking outside of the box and granting him the ability to speak via magic!
: MacCormack, please don’t-
scene yumimollyobstacles14
: Im tur-'t actuallui ped- edhelen...
: Hah...
scene yumimollyobstacles15
: Hey, uhh...this ain’t that permit thing we’re lookin’ for, is it? Just looks like more balls to me.
: That, uhh...no. I don’t think that’s it.
: Why are they on a string?
: Imani, who keeps putting these things in the ball pit?
: Hey, don’t look at me. Makoto’s the one with all the access to that stuff. Sides, there ain’t no way in hell I’d ever buy those. Noooo thank you.
: I’m, uhh...I’m gonna go back down now.
: Same.
scene yumimollyobstacles16
scene yumimollyobstacles17
: Got it! This time, I-
scene yumimollyobstacles18
: Aww, what the fuck? It’s just more of these weird balls. Why are there so many of them in here?
: Eureka! One permit to sell baked goods! Straight from the Produce Delivery Administration itself!
scene yumimollyobstacles19
: Bullshit! Bread ain’t a vegetable! Unless they moved the fuckin’ food groups around while I wasn’t paying attention!
: Permission to engage in slavery, Miss Watabe?!
: Haven’t you people done enough already?
: Go. The sooner this contest ends, the better.
scene yumimollyobstacles20
: In that case, might I interest you in a loaf our finest rustic bread, straight from the fiery mouth of a wood-fired communal?
: And yes, while it may appear to just be normal bread, this bread was baked by Nedgread Redgrog, the greatest dwarven baker in all of Kumon-mi. They say his cooking level is maxed out, you know.
: Can you try selling it to me like a normal human?
scene yumimollyobstacles21
: Ahh, so it is human bread you’re after. And for that, you’ve come to the right place.
: We sadly do not carry such a thing here, but for the price of just one loaf of our own, I’d be willing to point you in the direction you’re looking for to-
scene yumimollyobstacles22
: Yo! Goth teacher lady! I found my sales permit! Now, buy this bread or I’ll kick your ass!
: Sold — to the girl in checkers.
scene yumimollyobstacles23
: Fuck yeah! Throwing shit!
: What?! No! Buy my bread or I’ll kick your ass too!
: Unlikely. I believe I could take you even despite being partially handicapped. You’re going to have to try harder.
: But Yumi didn’t have to try at all!
: Her mom says she’s a natural salesperson! It’s probably just that, Molly! A girl whose name I definitely remember despite the green motif and flat chest!
: Stop hangin’ out with my fucking mom! It’s weird!
: This bread possesses magical qualities! And if you eat it at home, it will add to your rested bonus and increase stamina generation for the next twenty-four hours!
: Boring. Too many words. Do better.
: Then...uhh...buy this bread or I will keep talking to you!
: Sold. You may now proceed.
scene yumimollyobstacles24
: And I may go sit down as I imagine this next part will take one of you at least an hour.
: Oh, jeez. Wonder which one of us she could be talking about?
: How do I even hold these? The only thing I have experience throwing is competitive games when I’m forced to play DPS.
: You just fuckin’ do it, Ireland. How hard could it be? Just pretend it’s a potato and maybe you’ll get over your fears or some shit.
: Potatoes are for eating, not throwing! My ancestors who died during the famine would depart their graves just to kill me!
: Well, I’ll kill you if you keep distracting me! Hitting this target is harder than I thought!
scene yumimollyobstacles25
: You ain’t gotta throw it so fast, Yumi! You’ve gotta aim!
: The fuck is “aiming?!” I’m just trying to knock this damn thing over!
: Hey, Wakana. You seem to be having a good time.
: Go fuck yourself, Arakawa. What do you want?
: Just checking in. I didn’t like your monologue earlier.
: What a coincidence. I haven’t liked anything you’ve ever done in our entire history together.
: Not even the times I let you cry on me?
: Arakawa, those are the times I hate most of all. Now, please let me cherish what I hoped would be a rare moment of silence in the midst of endless gunfire.
: Or, alternatively, I could stand here and repeatedly comment on how pretty you are.
scene yumimollyobstacles26
: And risk angering the childhood friend that you supposedly love so dearly? Don’t make me laugh.
: I’ve heard that you’re practically her lap dog now. Which means you’d have no problem dumping me if she so much as asked you to.
: Wakana...that’s not jealousy I’m hearing, is it?

: It’s one thing to live a second life outside of our friendship. That, I can handle. But to hear that she’s trying to work her way in to your inner circle does frustrate me a little, yes. I wouldn’t call it jealousy, though.
: Well, what would you call it then?
: Not wanting to hear Imani bitch about it when you start disappearing into the restroom with a different girl.
: The solution here is that we all just go in there together.
: You sound like a drunken party girl. Get a grip, already.
: Fine. Just you and me then.
: In the restroom? I think not. I’ve done quite a good job of minimizing my online presence and the last thing I need is some idol painting a target on my back out of jealousy on her end.
: Fine. Then you get Niki and I get Imani. Or you get Imani and I get Niki. Or I get you and Imani gets Niki.
: And what role does Rika play in all of this?
: She can rotate between both groups.
scene yumimollyobstacles27
: Why will you not just let me rest?
: Some of my worst thoughts come when I’m “resting.” I’m just trying to distract you from yourself.
: Stop being nice. It’s making me nauseous.
: Want to go for a walk once the contest is done?
: Depends. Would you like to carry me?
: I could. Sure.
scene yumimollyobstacles28
: Then no thank you. The thought of being alone with you when that is on your mind does little to make me feel safe.
: Now, please leave or I will have to contact security and say you’ve been taking inappropriate pictures of the girls in the gym.
: They’re probably the ones taking inappropriate pictures of me at this point.
: Sometimes, I wish it was our school that had suddenly and mysteriously sunk into the earth.
scene yumimollyobstacles29
: Excellent job knocking over the Hercules Kabuterimon, Yumi. It made it much easier for me to get the ball into the beast’s mouth.
: You could’ve tried a little harder than just walking over and dropping it in, though.
: I could have, aye. But instead, I elected to save my energy for the final phase. Not everyone is fit to cast spells, you know.
: The incantations are tough as is, but that doesn’t even touch upon the physical strain that the expenditure of one’s mana places on the body.
: Okay, well, you’re the fuckin’ nerd here and I already got through the fun part. So just do whatever you want, I guess. I’ll just watch and make fun of you.
: Heh,  you seem to believe that I’m vulnerable to vicious mockery. But the truth is that I’ve developed an immunity over the years that makes me all but impervious to it.
: Aight. I’ll just kick the shit out of you if you get too annoying then.
: New idea — I’m just going to try casting some spells.
: Yeah, you do that.
: Munita sum...
: Custodi hanc domum!
: Uhh...Ego invoco deus ab mihi! Protego mihi ab hostili et malum!
: Praesidium!
: You’re really good at this.
: M-Maybe I’m...not supposed to be casting a defensive incantation? Maybe I need to...use an offensive one to spur the orb to action instead?
: Or maybe you just suck at magic.
: Well, I’d like to see you try! Like I said, the strain this puts on one’s body is not something to be scoffed at! You’d have likely collapsed from exhaustion by now!
: Maybe just be better. That should help, right?
: Propria manu...resurgam!
: Semper fortis! Semper liber! Tuebor!
: Abra kadabra.
scene yumimollyobstacles30
: Wha...no! This can’t be!
: Told you. You just suck. And I’m better at magic than you.
: I...Impossible! I’ve been practicing these incantations for years! All that effort...just to be defeated by the one magicians use to pull rabbits from a hat?! How will that protect my village?!
: Beats me, but I’m going to go claim my reward now. Sorry, Ireland.
scene yumimollyobstacles31
: No!!!! Noooooooooooo!!!!!!
told you it would work. now speak to the weird fucking turtle thing so we can get out of here and go back to being best friends.
: I don’t know how many times I need to tell you that you’re not my friend, but here. I’ll tell you again right now. You’re not my friend.
if i’m not your friend, how come we’re always spending so much time together?
: Oh, I don’t know. Because you live inside of my fucking head, maybe?
or maybe you just like me — and you look forward to the way i think for you so you don’t have to think for yourself.
things are tough now, aren’t they? not knowing whether your mother will live or die. not knowing where you and chika stand as friends.
and that’s not even mentioning how you have no idea if you’ll ever get to suck akira’s fat teacher-cock like it’s the meatiest popsicle in the whole wide-
: Wise turtle...instead of a point for the Dorm Wars, could you use your mysterious turtle powers to vaporize Pareidolia, please?
: Such a feat is beyond my power. But I will grant you victory and thank you for the affection you show my kind.
scene yumimollyobstacles32
: Holy fuck.
holy fuck.
: You actually talk?
it actually talks?
: We didn’t just mutually imagine that, did we?
we might have. shit’s so weird around here sometimes that i don’t even know anymore.
scene yumimollyobstacles33
: Okay, so...the Wise Turtle has spoken. Which means Yumi wins and my job here is done.
: You guys didn’t put, like...a speaker in that turtle or something, did you?
: That sounds like effort to me. And, much like Arakawa, I’m allergic to effort. So no.
: R...Right...Yeah. Guess I’ve seen some...weirder shit anyway, so...
scene yumimollyobstacles34
: Hah...that brings us to the end of our eighth competition. But also to the beginning of my nap time.
: Please stay tuned for the barista...thing...at Koi Cafe, coming up after this brief word from our sponsors.
scene black
It’s so cold on the moon.
